sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SHA2(COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(`accountId`,`username`,`email`,`role`,`status`,`createdAt`) AS CHAR),256) ORDER BY `accountId`,`username`,`email`,`role`,`status`,`createdAt` SEPARATOR ''),''),256) signature FROM `accounts`

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SHA2(COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(`profileId`,`accountId`,`fullName`,`gender`,`level`,`goal`,`sessionsPerWeek`,`status`) AS CHAR),256) ORDER BY `profileId`,`accountId`,`fullName`,`gender`,`level`,`goal`,`sessionsPerWeek`,`status` SEPARATOR ''),''),256) signature FROM `gymusers`

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SHA2(COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(`planId`,`title`,`description`,`creatorId`,`isTemplate`,`level`,`durationWeeks`,`createdAt`) AS CHAR),256) ORDER BY `planId`,`title`,`description`,`creatorId`,`isTemplate`,`level`,`durationWeeks`,`createdAt` SEPARATOR ''),''),256) signature FROM `workoutplans`

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SHA2(COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(`dayId`,`planId`,`dayName`,`order`,`weekDay`) AS CHAR),256) ORDER BY `dayId`,`planId`,`dayName`,`order`,`weekDay` SEPARATOR ''),''),256) signature FROM `workoutdays`

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SHA2(COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(`configId`,`exerciseId`,`dayId`,`sets`,`reps`,`restTime`,`order`) AS CHAR),256) ORDER BY `configId`,`exerciseId`,`dayId`,`sets`,`reps`,`restTime`,`order` SEPARATOR ''),''),256) signature FROM `exerciseconfigs`

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SHA2(COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(`exerciseId`,`name`,`description`,`difficulty`) AS CHAR),256) ORDER BY `exerciseId`,`name`,`description`,`difficulty` SEPARATOR ''),''),256) signature FROM `exercises`

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SHA2(COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(`alternativeId`,`exerciseId`,`alternativeExerciseId`,`priority`,`note`) AS CHAR),256) ORDER BY `alternativeId`,`exerciseId`,`alternativeExerciseId`,`priority`,`note` SEPARATOR ''),''),256) signature FROM `exercisealternatives`

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SHA2(COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(`profileId`,`planId`,`joinedAt`,`startedAt`,`status`) AS CHAR),256) ORDER BY `profileId`,`planId`,`joinedAt`,`startedAt`,`status` SEPARATOR ''),''),256) signature FROM `gymuserworkoutplans`

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SHA2(COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(`workoutSessionId`,`profileId`,`dayId`,`startTime`,`endTime`,`totalDuration`,`status`) AS CHAR),256) ORDER BY `workoutSessionId`,`profileId`,`dayId`,`startTime`,`endTime`,`totalDuration`,`status` SEPARATOR ''),''),256) signature FROM `workoutsessions`

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SHA2(COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(`performedExerciseId`,`workoutSessionId`,`exerciseId`,`originalExerciseId`,`isSubstituted`,`isActive`,`isCompleted`) AS CHAR),256) ORDER BY `performedExerciseId`,`workoutSessionId`,`exerciseId`,`originalExerciseId`,`isSubstituted`,`isActive`,`isCompleted` SEPARATOR ''),''),256) signature FROM `performedexercises`

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SHA2(COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(`setId`,`performedExerciseId`,`setNumber`,`weight`,`reps`,`preValue`) AS CHAR),256) ORDER BY `setId`,`performedExerciseId`,`setNumber`,`weight`,`reps`,`preValue` SEPARATOR ''),''),256) signature FROM `exercisesets`

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SHA2(COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(SHA2(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(`metricId`,`profileId`,`height`,`weight`,`recordedAt`) AS CHAR),256) ORDER BY `metricId`,`profileId`,`height`,`weight`,`recordedAt` SEPARATOR ''),''),256) signature FROM `bodymetrics`
